skill.summary: Edit PDFs with natural-language instructions using the nano-pdf CLI. And also 50+ models for image generation, video generation, text-to-speech, speech-to-te...

latestVersion.changelog:
nano-pdf v1.0.0 initial release:

- Introduces natural-language PDF editing via the nano-pdf CLI.
- Access to over 50 AI models for image/video generation, TTS, STT, music, chat, web search, and more.
- Unified API with smart model routing and direct model access across providers.
- Bash and Read tool support; requires SKILLBOSS_API_KEY.
- Includes detailed usage examples for key features.
